---
title: "initial_state_local"
description: "The initial state declares a local, but nothing exists yet to build it from."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** The initial state declares a local, but nothing exists yet to build it from.

**How to fix it:** Start in a state without a local and `goto` the state with the local from a message or `enter`.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
